resources.string: Android battery optimization is off for Theta.
Android battery optimization is on for Theta.

If a reply stops when you switch apps or lock the screen, check Theta’s battery settings. On ColorOS, choose Allow full background activity. Other systems may call this Unrestricted or let you lock Theta in Recents. These controls can apply even when Android battery optimization is off.
Open Settings → Apps → Theta → Battery to review background activity.
For background tasks and notifications, see Plugins and diagnostics.
